title: Leader answer — plan-gate (stage 2, scope §2.1, D3–D5, D18)
description: Common envelope + the plan-gate fields. plan needs every requirement row covered, no missing requirement and plan ≠ null; close-as-decided ⇔ close ≠ null. ENUM TEMPLATE: values like "{answers}" are placeholders that schema.fill_enums replaces for each call (codes.LEADER_SCHEMA_TOKENS); an id list that comes out empty drops its property (read as []). Keeps to type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum (the CLI's structured-output subset). Rules a schema cannot say (rerun ⇔ step, escalate ⇔ recommendation, coverage of every id, the situation rules) are checked by gxengine/leader.py (codes.LeaderFormatReason).

answer.description: One of the answers the engine allows for this call (rendered per call). The engine acts on this field only.

reason.description: Leader-decision reason code (§4.2, scope D20). Pick `other` only when no code fits.

step.description: The step to run again — set exactly when answer is rerun, otherwise null.

note.description: Free text for the next role (leader-decision.md), the human and evolve. The engine never branches on it.

recommendation.description: Set exactly when answer is escalate: what you recommend the human answers (scope D15). Otherwise null.

step.description: Set exactly when the recommended answer is rerun.

requirements.description: One entry per requirement-map row R1..Rn (engine-numbered), each exactly once.

covered.description: true = the row's ACs really cover this Issue requirement.

missing_requirements.description: Issue requirements with no row in the requirement map, one line each (empty if none). The engine counts them only.

plan.description: Set exactly when answer is plan.

reason.description: completed = already achieved; not-planned = decided not to do it.

close.description: Set exactly when answer is close-as-decided.
